run.procedureSummary: Script used: C:\Users\Jaket\AppData\Local\Temp\om\desk-250\opus_h2_7f3c91_sim.py (sha1 49d72010...). Each step runs on all six crucibles before the next step starts. Step 1, charge: add the cycle's charge to each crucible and ignore capacity. Step 2, overflow: go through crucibles 1 to 6 in order. If a crucible is over capacity, it drops to capacity and the excess goes to the next crucible before that crucible's turn, so the excess cascades. Crucible 6's excess goes to slag. Step 3, state: using the quantities after overflow, a BASE crucible at or above its upper mark becomes SUPERHEATED, a SUPERHEATED crucible at or below its lower mark becomes BASE, and every other crucible keeps its state. Step 4, bleed: every amount is worked out from the quantities after overflow, before anything moves, and then all moves happen at once. A BASE crucible sends floor(q/4) to slag. A SUPERHEATED crucible sends floor(q/2) to the crucible before it (i-1); crucible 1's amount goes to slag. A crucible that ends up over capacity is not overflowed again this cycle. Step 5, tap: if the six crucibles hold more than 38 in total (exactly 38 does not trigger), each crucible keeps floor(q/2) and q - floor(q/2) goes to slag.

openPoints.point: Which quantity the state check in step 3 uses
openPoints.assumption: The quantity after step 2 (charge, then overflow) in the same cycle.

openPoints.point: Which state the bleed in step 4 uses for a crucible that changed state in step 3 of the same cycle
How 'rounding down' applies in the bleed
openPoints.assumption: The amount moved is rounded down: floor(q/4) for BASE and floor(q/2) for SUPERHEATED, so the crucible keeps the remainder.

openPoints.point: How 'keeps half, rounded down' applies in the tap
openPoints.assumption: The amount kept is floor(q/2). The rest, which is the larger half when q is odd, goes to slag.
The sum of the six crucibles after step 4 in the same cycle. Slag is not counted. The tap fires only when the total is strictly greater than 38.

openPoints.point: A crucible over capacity after the bleed
openPoints.assumption: No overflow runs within the cycle. It is handled by the next cycle's step 2. At the end of cycle 5, crucible 2 holds 10 against a capacity of 8 and crucible 4 holds 7 against a capacity of 6, and both stay that way as the write-up says.

openPoints.point: What counts as a state change
openPoints.assumption: Only the transitions in step 3. No other step changes a state. The tap does not reset any state.
